Local-first knowledge graph for durable, provenance-backed AI memory · [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/knowledge-worker/) · [GitHub](https://github.com/rahulmranga/knowledge-worker) · May 2026 – present

Analytics and data platform engineer with 7+ years designing enterprise data products, cloud-native data platforms, and AI-enabled analytics across life sciences, manufacturing, retail, financial services, and supply chain. Builds modern data ecosystems on AWS, dbt, Snowflake, and Databricks, and integrates LLMs and knowledge graphs where they earn their place. Author of **knowledge-worker**, a published PyPI package giving AI assistants durable, provenance-backed memory: a local-first knowledge graph with graph analytics, LLM-backed ingest, and a hard provenance invariant. Generalist by nature — comfortable owning a problem from ingestion through modeling and tooling to the report on a stakeholder's desk — and experienced mentoring engineering teams and setting technical standards.

Local-first knowledge graph for durable, provenance-backed AI memory · [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/knowledge-worker/) · [GitHub](https://github.com/rahulmranga/knowledge-worker) · May 2026 – present

Designed a batch traceability data product on a **graph database (AWS Neptune)**, integrating LLM-extracted supplier data, **ERP (SAP)** data, and other enterprise systems — **accelerating batch release by 8%** while strengthening raw-material traceability for manufacturing investigations.

Delivered an end-to-end data product, from requirements gathering through implementation, covering **800+ quality and manufacturing data points** for commercial **CAR-T** operations, contributing to an improvement in manufacturing success rates from **74% to 92%**.

Architected and deployed an enterprise **self-service analytics platform** using **dbt, AWS Glue, Databricks, and CI/CD**, enabling the organization's **Unified Data Model (UDM)** initiative and empowering **50+ engineers** to deliver **400+** production-grade data products on a **Medallion architecture**.
Developed CXO-level KPI dashboards and automated Python reporting that standardized enterprise KPIs and accelerated decision-making across CAR-T (cell therapy) operations.
Designed an automated report rationalization process using intelligent string-matching, consolidating **70+ reports into seven standardized reports** to support a Snowflake migration.
Enhanced an enterprise risk prediction model for a **fintech** client, enabling proactive account retention that preserved approximately **$500K** in recurring revenue.

Also: **kompress-ultra** — context-management middleware experiments for AI agent frameworks (live-data TUI dashboards, knowledge-graph visualizations, Pages deploy pipeline). **AG-UI protocol** — open protocol work for agent/UI interoperability.
